name: pi-quarkus
description: Quarkus extension for pi — dev-mode management via quarkus-agent-mcp

scripts.sync: mkdir -p vendor && rm -rf vendor/yaml && mkdir -p vendor/yaml && cp ../shared/jsonrpc-session.ts ../shared/mcp-client.ts ../shared/context-filter.ts ../shared/spawn-safe.ts ../shared/maven-project-tree.ts ../shared/maven-version-lookup.ts vendor/ && YAML_DIR=$(node -e "console.log(require('node:path').dirname(require.resolve('yaml/package.json')))") && cp -R "$YAML_DIR/dist" vendor/yaml/dist && cp "$YAML_DIR/package.json" vendor/yaml/package.json
